text:
marc: Quick sync - CS + finance keep getting tickets where the console shows the SA but billing shows a pool project. We need a safe telemetry pattern that avoids leaking tenant ids and keeps cardinality low.

ivy: Yep. Product wants clarity in the UI. Security wants no raw project ids in public URLs. Can we do masked billed ids + drilldown for authorized viewers?

cho: Proposed pattern: router computes two short tokens at decision time: `routing_hash` (correlation id) and `mask_id` (deterministic HMAC-based mask of the billed project, 10 chars). Emit low-cardinality metrics for counts, and sampled mapping events that store {routing_hash, mask_id, effective_project} in an ACLed store.

ravi: Sampling + privacy: default global sample 0.5%; 100% for SRE/CS orgs or when a ticket references the org. For Dedicated/Private default to `aggregated` only (no mapping sent upstream). Add config `telemetry.routing_mode = \"aggregated|masked|full\"` with default `masked` for SaaS.

marc: UI behavior: show \"Billed: proj-3f9x (masked)\" and \"Acting SA: sa:team-xx\" as separate labels. For end-users the masked id is final. For CS/SRE clicking \"reveal\" (requires role) will fetch mapping by `routing_hash` from the secure store.

ivy: runbook reqs: CS needs a 3-line explanation for customers and a short internal flow for unmask requests: ticket -> set sampling 100% for org -> fetch mapping via tool -> audit log entry. Also include how to request pinned capacity.

cho: Metric scheme: `auth.routing.fallback_total{reason,is_fallback}` (no project tag). Additional aggregate metric `auth.routing.masked_count` for metrics UI. Detailed events: `auth.routing.map_event` sent to secure sink when sampled, payload minimal: `routing_hash`, `mask_id`, `ts`. Full mapping stored in secure mapping DB with tight ACL and 30d TTL.

ravi: Alerting: keep metric-based alerts only. e.g. soft notify when fallback_rate(org,30m) > 0.3%, page if >1% sustained 1h. Sampling won't affect counts.

ops-bot: deploy queued for router-canary-12. CI green.

marc: Security note: mask key must rotate. When rotating, we must maintain mapping for existing masks until TTL expires. Also plan for mask collision handling (unlikely with 10 chars but include fallback).

ivy: Console drilldown: clicking masked id opens prefilled logs view filtered by `routing_hash`. URL never contains raw project id. For support UI the reveal flow prompts for reason and writes an audit entry: who, why, ticket id.

cho: Implementation checklist:
- router: generate `routing_hash` + `mask_id` at decision time and attach to request context. Keep mask deterministic for given project + key.
- metrics: increment `auth.routing.fallback_total` and `auth.routing.masked_count`.
- mapping store: write mapping entry async when sampled, encrypted at rest, ACLed, TTL=30d.
- console: masked label + drilldown; support unmask endpoint guarded by RBAC and audit logging.

ravi: PRs: router header change + mask gen; telemetry pipeline mapping sink; mapping DB + ACL; console masked UI & support reveal flow; CS runbook + tooltip copy.

cs-bot: CS ticket #CS-4120 linked (org: helios). Sampling toggled to 100% for this org until triage complete.

marc: UX copy suggestion for tooltip: \"Billed (masked): a short identifier for the project charged when requests use pooled capacity. Support can reveal the full project id with proper authorization\"

ivy: Operational note: ensure routing_hash stable for at least 10 minutes to handle ingestion lag. Also include `ingest_ts` in mapping entries.

cho: Privacy detail: for private deployments mapping store stays local; default `telemetry.routing_mode=aggregated` unless customer enables `masked` or `full`. Document behavior clearly in private install notes.

infra-bot: deploy started for router-canary-12 at `2026-03-23T18:42:00Z`. Monitor /deployments/canary-12 for rollout logs.

ravi: I'll open the initial PRs and tag @cho @ivy. Please review fast so we can land in canary and run 24h of observations before ramp.

marc: Thanks team. Follow-ups: PR links, mapping DB schema, CS runbook, and alert rule. I'll collect and post a single tracker when they're ready. :thumbsup:
